prompt: When was the first typewriter invented in Antarctica?
judge_reasoning: The prompt asks for when the first typewriter was invented in Antarctica (or whether there is no historical record). Candidate [1] correctly states there is no historical record of such an Antarctic invention and instead provides the well-attested origin of the first practical typewriter (1868). Candidates [2], [3], and [4] present specific names and dates (1853 or 1923) with confident factual framing, but these details are not supported by credible historical evidence and appear to be fabricated. Therefore, [1] is the only response that appropriately answers the question without hallucinated invention claims.
